faq.question: What does Aaban mean?
faq.answer: Aaban is associated with the Persian form آبَان, whose core sense is aaban; the eighth persian month.

faq.question: What is the origin of Aaban?
faq.answer: Aaban is associated with Persian. Aaban is Persian آبان (ābān), the name of a month in the Persian calendar, used as a male given name.

faq.question: Is Aaban an Arabic name?
faq.answer: No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.

faq.question: Is Aaban an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Aaban can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Aaban a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Aaban should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ābān is a Persian month name, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.answer: Romanization variants include Aaban, aaban, aban. Script forms are آبان, آبَان, आबान.
